--
## Summary

When uploading a gallery image (or a document), default its title/name to the uploaded file's name instead of a timestamp.

## Motivation

Gallery uploads currently default the title to the current date/time, which is rarely what the user wants and forces manual renaming:

```ts
// frontend/src/hooks/useUploadQueue.ts  and  MemberPhotos.tsx
await useGalleryStore.getState().addGalleryImage({
  file: item.file,
  title: formatDateTime(new Date()),   // ← should default to the file name
  ...
});
```

The file name is already available (`item.file.name` / `file.name`). A sensible default is the file's base name (extension stripped).

## Proposed approach

- Gallery: default `title` to the uploaded file's base name in both `useUploadQueue` and `MemberPhotos` upload paths.
- Documents: apply the same default in the document create flow (`DocumentDialog`) when a file is attached and no title has been entered.
- Keep it as a *default* only — don't overwrite a title the user already typed.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Newly uploaded gallery images default their title to the file's (base) name
- [ ] Document creation defaults the title to the attached file's name when the title is empty
- [ ] A user-entered title is never overwritten
- [ ] i18n unaffected (no hard-coded strings); `CHANGELOG.md` entry under `## [Unreleased]`

## Relevant Files

- `frontend/src/hooks/useUploadQueue.ts`
- `frontend/src/components/shared/member-sheet/MemberPhotos.tsx`
- `frontend/src/components/shared/member-sheet/DocumentDialog.tsx`

We're implementing GitHub issue #777 in the family-tree repo (a React+TS frontend / FastAPI backend app). Repo root: /home/codex/projects/family-tree. Current branch: feat/777-default-upload-title-from-filename (branched fresh off origin/main).

## Issue #777 summary
When uploading a gallery image (or a document), default its title/name to the uploaded file's name instead of a timestamp.

Currently:
- `frontend/src/hooks/useUploadQueue.ts` (line ~163-171, inside `runWorker`'s per-item async upload): calls `useGalleryStore.getState().addGalleryImage({ file: item.file, title: formatDateTime(new Date()), description: null, linkedMemberIds: [] }, { refresh: false })`. This is the bulk/multi-file upload queue (drag-and-drop into the gallery view). The `UploadQueueItem` already carries `file: File` and `name: string` (= `file.name`), so the file name is available at this call site.
- `frontend/src/components/shared/member-sheet/MemberPhotos.tsx` (line ~32-43, `uploadFile(file: File)`): calls `addGalleryImage({ file, title: formatDateTime(new Date()), description: null, linkedMemberIds: [member.id] })`. This is the single/multi upload from a member's Photos section.
- `frontend/src/components/shared/member-sheet/DocumentDialog.tsx`: `handleFilesPicked(fileList)` (line ~173-188) adds picked files into `added: PendingFile[]` state (each `{ tempId, filename: file.name, file }`), used to populate an "Attached files" list in the dialog. Separately, `formData.title` (line ~331-341, an `<Input>` bound to `formData.title`) is the *document's own title* field (required, the whole document's title — NOT a per-file filename). The issue asks: "apply the same default in the document create flow (DocumentDialog) when a file is attached and no title has been entered" — i.e., when the user attaches a file via `handleFilesPicked` while creating a new document (no existing `document` prop) and `formData.title` is still empty, default `formData.title` to that first attached file's base name (extension stripped). Must not overwrite a title the user already typed, and must not clobber the title on subsequent file adds if one was already defaulted-and-then-edited by the user vs. still at its auto-defaulted value — use your judgment on the simplest correct rule (issue only requires: default when attaching a file AND title is currently empty; never overwrite a user-entered title).

## Requirement (base-name extraction)
"A sensible default is the file's base name (extension stripped)." E.g. `IMG_1234.jpg` → `IMG_1234`. This base-name-stripping logic is needed in at least 2 files (useUploadQueue.ts, MemberPhotos.tsx) and arguably DocumentDialog.tsx too — decide where a shared helper should live (likely a new small utility, e.g. in `frontend/src/utils/`, following existing conventions — check `frontend/src/utils/dateUtils.ts` and `frontend/src/utils/attachmentUtils.ts` for the project's style: named exports, no classes) vs. inlining. Look for any existing filename-base-name utility first (grep for "basename" or similar) before adding a new one — don't duplicate if something already exists.

## Explicitly OUT of scope (already done)
A related idea — defaulting the gallery photo's *taken date* (createdAt) from the image's EXIF metadata — is NOT part of this task. It was already fully implemented server-side in a prior PR: `backend/app/api/routes/gallery.py` line ~132-157 calls `store_image_upload(..., extract_exif_date=True)` and falls back `created_at=created_at or exif_date_taken`, backed by `_extract_exif_date_taken` in `backend/app/services/storage.py`. Do not touch EXIF/date logic at all — confirm in the plan that this is out of scope so the implementer doesn't waste time on it.

## Acceptance criteria (from the issue)
- Newly uploaded gallery images default their title to the file's (base) name
- Document creation defaults the title to the attached file's name when the title is empty
- A user-entered title is never overwritten
- i18n unaffected (no hard-coded strings) — this change shouldn't need any new translation strings since it's just a default value, not new UI text
- CHANGELOG.md entry under `## [Unreleased]` (repo already has this section — see top of CHANGELOG.md; this is a small user-facing enhancement, likely fits under "Changed")

## What I need from you
Produce a concrete, file-by-file implementation plan (not code, but precise enough that an implementer just translates it 1:1):
1. Whether/where to add a shared "strip file extension to get base name" utility (exact file path, function signature, edge cases to handle: no extension, dotfiles like `.gitignore`, multiple dots like `photo.raw.jpg`, leading/trailing whitespace).
2. Exact change to `useUploadQueue.ts`'s upload call — replace `formatDateTime(new Date())` with the derived base name of `item.file.name` (or `item.name`, same value).
3. Exact change to `MemberPhotos.tsx`'s `uploadFile` — same idea using `file.name`.
4. Whether `formatDateTime`/`dateUtils` import becomes unused in either file after this change and needs removing (check both files' other usages of `formatDateTime`).
5. Exact change to `DocumentDialog.tsx`'s `handleFilesPicked` — the precise condition for defaulting `formData.title` (only when creating a new document, i.e. `!document`? or does it also apply when editing an existing document with an empty title? Re-read the issue: "Document creation defaults the title..." — lean toward only the create flow, but check whether restricting to `!document` is over-engineering vs. just checking `formData.title` is empty regardless of edit/create — pick the simpler rule that satisfies the acceptance criteria and justify it briefly).
6. Confirm no backend changes are needed (this is 100% frontend).
7. CHANGELOG.md — exact entry text and which section.
8. Any existing unit tests covering these files/functions that will need updating (check for `useUploadQueue.test.ts`, `MemberPhotos.test.tsx`, `DocumentDialog.test.tsx` or similar under frontend/src, and whether new tests should be added for the base-name utility).

Keep the plan tight and actionable — this is a small, well-scoped change. Report back the full plan as your final answer.
